game.title: The Surge
game.blurb: Sci-fi action RPG in which a worker in an exo-suit fights through a broken factory complex, from Deck13 and Focus Home Interactive, released 2017-05-15. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The journey through the CREO complex, boss by boss. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: Dying, Tech Scrap and Levels
chapters.summary: Dying and recovering your Tech Scrap, carrying large amounts, Core Power, weapon proficiency, the S&R Squad Chief Helvig fight and the all-achievements goal.

chapters.title: Gear and Crafting
chapters.summary: Full GOLIATH, OPERATOR and SENTINEL sets and Nano Core upgrades.

chapters.title: The Popcorn Parade and Rusty Spring Tower
chapters.summary: Achievements naming Carbon Cat, Iron Maus, the mascot heads, the Popcorn Parade, Rusty Rat and the Rusty Spring Tower.

chapters.title: Project Resolve Episodes and Frontier Gear
chapters.summary: Achievements naming the Project Resolve Center, episodes and modifiers, Frontier gear and weapons and the Testing Chamber audiologs.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for The Surge (API returned missing for "The Surge" and for "The Surge (2017)"). thesurge.fandom.com answers the API, with about 20 linked pages, including "Missions", "Locations" and "Implants"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 41 of 67 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. The first achievement says "all achievements in the base game", so the later ones (about 48 to 67, naming Carbon Cat, the Popcorn Parade, Rusty Spring Tower, the Project Resolve Center and episodes) are probably add-on content; no add-on names appear in the data, so the two add-on chapters are named after places and things in the achievement text. Hidden ones in that range (for example "Sniffing Around", "New Gear", "Good Listener", "One-Armed Bandit", "Bling-Bling", "End of Transmission", "Desecration") may belong to those add-on chapters but still sit in the main story. "Melting Down" (all five smelting machines) was put in the main story; "Squad Chief Helvig" was left in the general chapter because nothing in the data places it. RAWG lists a playtime of only 4 hours, which looks low.
